page.overview:
Who is Ferumbras Took II?

Ferumbras II Took was a Hobbit of the Shire and the twenty-fourth Shire-thain.

Ferumbras was the eldest son of Isumbras III Took and was born in SR 1101. Despite being a Shire-thain, Ferumbras was eclipsed by his younger brother, Bandobras, who won the Battle of the Green Fields. His son, Fortinbras succeeded him as Shire-thain.
